Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description:We are looking for a Laboratory Engineer for the department Material Technology in KarlskronaNKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and plays a central role in the global transition to renewable energy. At our factory in Karlskrona, we design, develop and manufacture high-voltage power cable solutions that enable a sustainable future. We are now looking for a Laboratory Engineer to join our Material Technology department, a role where you will combine laboratory work with a key responsibility for our digital lab environment.
  
 Shape the future of our laboratory systemsAs a Laboratory Engineer at NKT, you will not only contribute with reliable and accurate test results, you will also take on a central role in developing, maintaining and supporting our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).
  
 You will act as a link between laboratory users, instruments and system suppliers, ensuring that our systems support the business in an efficient and sustainable way. This is a broad and diverse role where you work both operationally and strategically.
  
 Main resnonsibilities:
  Plan, perform and report laboratory work according to applicable standards and instructions
 Quality control of incoming material and quality assurance of manufacturing steps
 Operate and maintain laboratory equipment
 Develop, adapt and improve the LIMS environment based on business need
 Identify and resolve issues across system, instruments and workflows
 Act as main point of contact towards system suppliers and support improvements
 Provide user support and training in LIMS to ensure efficient daily use
 Handle system administration and ensure stable system performance
  
 
 Who are you?You are an organized and structured colleague who enjoys working both practically in the lab and with digital tools and systems. You are curious, solution-oriented and take initiative to improve ways of working.You thrive in a role where you collaborate broadly, support colleagues and manage of both processes and systems. 
  
 Key requirements:
  Bachelor’s degree in engineering, chemistry, physics – or equivalent experience
 Good communication skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written
 Experience or interest in working with databases and digital systems
 Structured, service-minded and comfortable supporting users
  
 
 Contact and applicationNKT is committed to fostering a diverse organization and an inclusive culture where people from different backgrounds can thrive and perform at their best. You will gain exciting opportunities for career development and attractive benefits.
  
 Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!

 If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please reach out to Agnes Carlsson, agnes.carlsson@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail. Due to the holiday season, we kindly ask for your understanding that our response times may be slightly longer than usual.

jobs.occupation: Sales Account Manager to Ex-Change Parts
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in the global helicopter aftermarket and develop sales with customers across international markets? We are now looking for a Sales Account Manager to join Ex-Change Parts and contribute to the company's continued growth.

About Ex Change Parts
Ex-Change Parts AB operates within the global aviation industry and specializes in helicopter support, including the sale, exchange and related services for helicopter parts and components. The company has over 26 years of industry experience and serves more than 2,000 customers worldwide.
Ex-Change Parts has a strong position within the international helicopter aftermarket and works with customers across both commercial and military aviation. The company works with several helicopter models, including the Super Puma family and smaller helicopter models.
 About the Role
As a Sales Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing sales within your assigned markets and building strong, lasting relationships with both existing and prospective customers. You will have an international focus and work closely with customers to understand their needs, identify new business opportunities and provide the right solutions.
The role includes a high volume of quotations, customer follow ups and orders, as well as close collaboration with internal teams. You will also prepare and conduct customer meetings and represent the company at trade shows and other industry events.
Responsibilities and Tasks

Develop and maintain relationships with existing and new customers.

Identify customer needs, new business opportunities and customer needs.

Manage quotations, follow up with customers and handle orders throughout the sales process.

Prepare and present products and solutions to customers.

Analyze customer and market data to support pricing and sales decisions.

Work closely with internal teams to ensure the right products and solutions are offered.

Travel internationally for customer meetings and trade shows.

Your Experience and Skills
We are looking for a driven salesperson with experience in B2B or technical sales. Experience from the aviation industry, preferably within helicopters, is a strong advantage but not a requirement. A strong background in technical sales can also be a great fit for the role.
We see that you have:

Experience in B2B or technical sales.

Fluent Swedish and excellent English, both spoken and written.

Experience working with international customers.

A strong commercial mindset and a drive to achieve results.

The ability to understand and sell technically complex products.

Meritorious:

Experience working with aircraft or helicopter component sales.

Knowledge of the aviation industry.

Understanding of FAA and EASA certification of parts.

As a person, you are driven, positive and comfortable meeting and communicating with different types of people. You enjoy working towards clear goals and are motivated by achieving results together with your team. You are curious, flexible and comfortable taking responsibility for your work.

We Offer
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well established company operating in the international aviation market. You will become part of an international company where you get the opportunity to develop your skills, build a global network and have a direct impact on the business.
You will work in an entrepreneurial environment with short paths to decision making, a high level of responsibility and a team that is driven, customer focused and enjoys working together.
• Hybrid working and a high level of flexibility.
• International travel and the opportunity to build a global network.
• Generous wellness benefits.
• Strong focus on work life balance.
• Generous pension conditions and parental leave top up.
• Social activities and team events.
• A family oriented and transparent company culture.

Welcome with your application!
We look forward to receiving your application! The recruitment process is managed by Ed:Za Group. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact ebba.jidell@edzagroup.se.

Do you enjoy product development and want to be involved in the creation from sketch to finished product? Now you have the chance to become an important part of our mechanics group and help us shape future products. In this role, you have good opportunities to be part of and influence our development journey! We are now looking for a Mechanical Lead Engineer for our Multi Channel Products team at our HQ in Lund, Sweden.
Your future team
We're a team of 25 passionate mechanical engineers of all ages and backgrounds who share a love for technology and solving complex challenges. We place a strong emphasis on creativity, collaboration, and openness. You'll find yourself surrounded by supportive colleagues who are always eager to help and contribute to your growth. We have a fantastic collaboration and team spirit. As an employee of the MCP (Multi Channel Products) mechanics group, you will participate actively in projects with different challenges and focuses. We often develop completely new products with innovation possibilities. At MCP, we develop Multidirectional cameras, Panoramic cameras, and Modular cameras.
What you'll do here as a Mechanical Lead Engineer
As Lead Engineer for our mechanics team, you will play a key role in structuring and driving the mechanical development process in your product project. Together with the project manager, you will plan and coordinate activities, ensuring that priorities, schedules, and resources are aligned. You will guide the mechanical engineers, build efficient ways of working, and secure smooth collaboration with other disciplines and global suppliers. While much of your focus will be on creating clarity, structure, and teamwork, you will also stay closely involved in the technical development - contributing your expertise and curiosity to shape smart, reliable, and innovative mechanical solutions.
As you will have significant responsibility for developing new products, often taking them from the initial concept stage through to the finished product, you will also work closely with the implementation of the product in volume production. In this phase, you will collaborate with quality engineers, production technicians, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
Who are you?
We're looking for a passionate and hands-on product development engineer to lead the mechanical development of our next-generation Multi Channel products. You are someone who thrives on solving complex engineering challenges while inspiring others to do their best work.
You bring structure, clear communication, and an easygoing, collaborative approach. You lead by example, staying close to the technical details while guiding your team forward.
We believe you hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering and have at least 5 years of experience in mechanical design and product development. Experience with die-casting, injection molding, production, mechanical and environmental testing is highly valued. Proficiency in 3D CAD and fluency in English, both written and spoken, are essential.
What Axis has to offer
We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. 
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. 
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: 
Axis Career Hub 
Life at Axis blog  
Engineering at Axis blog 
Innovation at Axis 
Ready to act?
Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

Company description:
At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries. NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.
Job description:Are you ready to join a trusted supplier in the energy sector and contribute to a sustainable future? NKT is seeking a Monitoring and Sensing Specialist to develop advanced monitoring and sensing technologies for high voltage cable system. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a team of specialists in a multidisciplinary environment for improving reliability, safety, and performance of critical power transmission infrastructure. Do you want to be part of a global network of technical partners and business units?    Advance innovation in monitoring and sensing As a Monitoring and Sensing Specialist, you will promote innovation, enhance the maturity of emerging technologies, and facilitate the digital transformation of cable monitoring solutions. Your responsibility will be to support the development of sensing technology for high-voltage cable systems by:  
 Evaluating and recommending monitoring and sensing technologies.
 Signal processing and data analysis from sensors.
 Developing algorithms using sensor data, signal analysis and modelling physical phenomena.
 Managing multidisciplinary R&D projects and publicly funded research consortia. 
 Preparing technical documentation, reports, and presentations for stakeholders. 
 
 You will collaborate with internal NKT business units, external partners, customers, suppliers, universities, and research institutes to understand customer needs and business drivers, evaluate emerging monitoring and sensing technologies, and identify innovative solutions for high-voltage cable systems. 
 The position is based in Västerås, reporting to the Applied Mechanics Department. We offer the possibility to work from home 2 days per week. 
Profile description:Skilled engineer driven by innovation We are looking for an engineer or scientist with a solid background in sensing, signal processing, or applied modelling, and an interest in combining these disciplines to solve practical engineering challenges. You are a communicative and self-managed person who enjoys collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.  
 You should have:
  M.Sc. or higher in Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience with signal processing, data analysis and simulations
 Experience applying AI and machine-learning methods to develop engineering solutions is beneficial
 Experience with project management, including the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and coordinate cross-functional collaboration is beneficial
 Knowledge in new product development and/or innovation management is beneficial
 Good knowledge of English, both verbal and written.   
  
Be part of our growth journey  
 NKT is committed to developing a diverse organization and culture where people of diverse backgrounds can grow and are inspired to do their best. We have high ambitions on establishing gender diversity at NKT and encouraging all interested candidates to apply – even if you don’t tick all the boxes described. We believe that a diverse organization enables long-term performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture creates a better work environment. 
 We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 9th of December. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process.     If you have any questions about the role, you are very welcome to contact Hiring Manager Giampaolo Martufi at Giampaolo.Martufi@nkt.com. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Global Talent Attraction Specialist at angelina.nilsson@nkt.com.   
  Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.    Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

Do you enjoy hands-on electronics work and turning ideas into working prototypes?
You will join our Technology team, a group of around 20 colleagues working with electronics for our robotic lawn mowers. The team brings together a mix of employees and consultants with expertise across hardware development, detailed electronics design, test development, lab activities, and supporting engineering systems.
It is a collaborative and practical environment where you will work closely with hardware engineers and other specialists throughout the development process.
Role Description:
In this role, you will be part of our Lab & Test team, supporting our electronics development with practical lab work. You will work closely with hardware engineers and other colleagues across the team, helping them modify circuit boards, build prototypes and prepare electronics for development and testing. Your main tasks will include:
Responsible for maintaining and supporting the soldering lab.
Advanced soldering, including manual SMD rework on PCBAs
Modifying and troubleshooting electronic assemblies
Building electronic and electromechanical prototypes
Supporting engineers with practical electronics and lab activities
Working according to ESD and EPA requirements

Your profile
We believe you have a practical background in electronics, for example from electronics manufacturing, EMS, electronics production or a similar environment. You are comfortable working hands-on with circuit boards and electronic components and have a good general understanding of electronics and electromechanical circuits. You have:
Around 3-4 years of relevant experience, particularly if you have worked extensively with soldering and electronics service
Strong skills in manual soldering and SMD rework
Good knowledge of ESD and EPA practices
Good communication skills in Swedish and English

Experience with 3D modelling and 3D printing and knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC-7711, or similar soldering standards is a plus.
This is an on-site role, where access to the electronics lab and close collaboration with the team are an important part of the everyday work.
Location
Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.
Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Fredrik Huus. fredrik.huus@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.
Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here.

Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – Machine Foundation to join our SW Platform organisation. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role you’ll help shape the core software that every machine application relies on, from our Linux-based operating system to the base functionality and middleware that support it.
 Do you enjoy working close to technology, collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Then we’d love to hear from you.
 Your mission
 As Product Owner you’re responsible for the Machine Foundation product stream. You work with two agile development teams:
  OS team: develops our Linux-based operating system, including the service OS and secure boot.
 Base & Middleware team: works with base functionality and middleware that support the applications running on our machines.
  
You connect the teams with their stakeholders, mainly the internal teams that build on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap, and you shape what goes into the OS. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value.
 You work closely with each team’s Scrum Master and Tech Lead, and you collaborate with our architects in the direction of the base and middleware areas. You work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap, take part in cross-team planning and contribute to release go/no-go decisions. Each team has about 5–8 members.
 You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.
Profile description:Your profile
  You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.
 You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.
 You have an interest in software development and enjoy discussions with developers and architects.
 It’s a plus if you have experience with embedded Linux, operating systems, middleware or platform software, for example in industrial, automotive or similar products.
 You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  
As a person, you’re structured, communicative and collaborative. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and handle different perspectives with care. You enjoy working with people as much as with technology and like to keep learning together with others.
 We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products.
 Location
 The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office.
 Application and contacts
 Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November.
 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media. 
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Manager for External Design
jobs.description:
The opportunity 
At Hitachi Energy Power Transformers in Ludvika, we develop and deliver some of the world's most advanced transformers, supporting the global transition to a more sustainable energy system.
We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Manager to lead our External Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for a group of highly skilled engineers working with customer-driven projects in close collaboration with production, project management, quality, supply chain, and customers around the world.
This is a people-focused leadership role where success is built through trust, collaboration, technical excellence, and long-term competence development. You will lead an experienced team, support individual growth, and create conditions for engineers to perform their best while delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.
As part of the Power Transformers Engineering Management Team, you will contribute to the continued development of our engineering organization and help shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.
Ludvika has been at the center of power transmission innovation for more than a century. Here, you will combine local teamwork and long-term relationships with the opportunity to contribute to projects that support energy transition on a global scale.
How you’ll make an impact
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15–20 mechanical engineers.
Foster a culture built on collaboration, ownership, safety, and continuous learning.
Support competence development and long-term succession planning within the team.
Work closely with project management, production, quality, and other engineering functions to ensure successful project execution.
Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, quality, and operational performance.
Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and sound engineering judgement.
Contribute to the strategic development of the Mechanical Design organization.
Create an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and challenged to grow

Your background
You hold a degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent knowledge through substantial experience in a technical field.
You have experience from engineering, product development, manufacturing, project execution, or another industrial environment.
Previous leadership experience is beneficial but not required. We are equally interested in experienced leaders and strong technical professionals ready to take the next step.
Experience from transformers, power systems, heavy industry, manufacturing, mechanical design, or related technical fields is an advantage.
You enjoy working with people and understanding how to build engagement, trust, and high-performing teams.
You are comfortable balancing day-to-day operational needs with longer-term strategic objectives.
You communicate effectively with engineers, specialists, project managers, production teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.
You are fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

CellaVision is a global leader in digital microscopy, delivering complete solutions that combine advanced instruments, reagents, and software to support healthcare services worldwide. Our vision is clear: To elevate healthcare through the evolution of microscopy - in a sustainable way.
We work at the forefront of technology and use advances in programming, chemistry, digital imaging, and machine learning. Joining CellaVision means playing an important role in supporting healthcare through the continued evolution of microscopy.
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Location: Lund, Sweden
Job type: Full Time, Permanent
How will you contribute?
As a member of an Applications team, you will develop algorithms and software for our analyzers that automatically locate and pre-classify cells. Working together in the Application team, you will specialize in programming and digital image processing, used in our software to automatically detect, and classify cells and other objects in blood and body fluids. You will contribute to our entire development process, from algorithm development, implementation, code reviews, and documentation, to the creation and execution of tests.
As a Senior Software Engineer your work will involve:
Act as technical lead and advisor for SW development.
Develop and maintain Windows desktop applications for lab personnel, using C++, C# and WPF.
Develop and maintain backend services for coordinating access to databases and connecting labs, using C++ and SQL.
Develop algorithms within digital imaging using C++ and Python.
Develop and maintain existing products within Product care.
Perform troubleshooting and testing as part of the quality work.
Conduct investigations and research tasks.
Review designs, reports, and source code contributions from colleagues.
Participate in cross-functional demos and forums as team representative.
Mentor more junior colleagues.

What will you bring?
M.Sc. in Engineering within an appropriate field.
Extensive experience in programming skills in C++ or C#.
Experience in machine learning is a bonus.
Very good ability to understand the overall architecture and design of large software systems.
Very good ability to take initiatives and come up with new proposals for working methods as well a strong sense of responsibility.
Very good at evaluating and solving problems.
Very good English communication skills, verbal and written.
Experience in product development involving electronics, mechanics, and software.

What We Offer
Inclusive, Innovative Culture: Work in an international, collaborative environment focused on executing big ideas and adding customer value.
Work-Life Balance: Flexible hours and reduced working hours to help maintain balance.
Job Security: We offer a collective agreement, including comprehensive insurance, occupational pension, parental leave supplements, and more.
Health & Wellbeing: We support your health with free access to a gym, wellness allowance, lunch benefits, sponsored running competitions, and discounts on gym memberships.
Modern Workplace: Enjoy a vibrant, collaborative office environment that encourages teamwork and innovation.
Team Spirit: Join us for weekly breakfasts and fun team-building activities.

Ready to Join Us?
This is a full-time position based at our CellaVision HQ in Lund, Sweden—a modern office with great infrastructure and commuting options. We’re looking for someone to start as soon as possible.
Apply Now! Follow the application form and attach your resume by November 30, at the latest. We’re excited to hear from you!
Please note that you need a valid working permit in Sweden for this role.
Diversity is in our blood.
CellaVision is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.
We decline all contact regarding services in advertising, consulting, or recruitment.
About Us
CellaVision is a global leader in digital cell morphology within hematology, and our analyzers are trusted in healthcare services around the world. We focus on innovation, working with the latest in programming, digital imaging, and machine learning to provide value to our customers. By joining us, you'll be part of a creative, skilled team shaping the future of medical technology.

Company Description
AFRY is a European leader in engineering, design, and advisory services, with a global reach. We accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society. We are 17,000 devoted experts in infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalisation, creating sustainable solutions for generations to come. 
Continuous learning of all our employees is critical for our ability to deliver on our business strategy. We need to develop the right skills and foster a culture of continuous learning to win in a complex and competitive market. We want to offer dynamic and proactive learning opportunities for our people to develop themselves.

Job Description
Group Treasury is responsible for managing and coordinating the AFRY Group’s financial activities and financial risk exposure. The team consists of five dedicated professionals and plays a central role in supporting the company’s financial stability and growth. In this position, you will join a close-knit and collaborative team in a broad and dynamic role encompassing cash management, cash flow forecasting, bank guarantees, KYC processes, treasury operations, and related back-office activities. You will gain exposure to a wide range of treasury disciplines while working closely with stakeholders across the organization.
Group Treasury is also driving several development initiatives, including the enhancement of cash management processes, banking relationships, and the treasury system landscape. As a key member of the team, you will play an integral role in shaping and implementing these initiatives, contributing to the continued development and efficiency of the treasury function.

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate with a post-secondary education in finance, economics, or equivalent. Previous experience from a corporate treasury function, particularly within treasury operations, is considered an advantage. You are able to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. As the role involves active participation in and leadership of development projects, we are looking for someone with strong coordination skills and a proven ability to drive initiatives, manage stakeholders, and contribute to successful project delivery.
Main responsibilities
Support in preparation of monthly financial statements and reporting
Manage bank and corporate guarantees
Financial payments and transactions and related administration
Responsible for banking authorizations and bank administration together with our Treasury Specialist
Management of cashpools, group netting, and liquidity forecasting
Main KYC contact person towards banks
Maintaining key processes and static data in the Treasury Management System
Actively participate in improvement projects within the Group Treasury

You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders. While being an effective team player, you are also self-driven and comfortable taking ownership of your areas of responsibility. You are an excellent communicator, with a structured yet flexible approach, enabling you to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
You are analytical, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a genuine curiosity and a passion for continuous improvement. You enjoy learning new things and contributing to the development of processes, systems, and ways of working. As AFRY is a global organization, you communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
We highly value personal qualities and look for individuals who embody AFRY's values: Brave, Devoted, and Team Player.

Additional Information
The position is a full-time, located at the headquarter in Solna, Sweden or in the office in Vantaa, Finland. You will report to the Group's Head of Treasury.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career in intellectual property?

Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
We are seeking a post doc for a research project focused on understanding biodiversity in managed boreal forests. The project is part of a larger SLU research initiative (the Key Performance Indicator Project) where several researchers, postdocs and PhDs are currently involved, which opens opportunities for collaboration. 
This post doc will focus on issues that concern biodiversity conservation in managed forests by analysing species and structure data from a large-scale field survey conducted in both Sweden and Finland. The research will focus on lichens and polypore fungi, using HMSC modeling to learn how their biodiversity varies based on local forest management and landscape variables. The post doc will work at the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies in Umeå and become a part of a strong research environment focusing on restoration ecology, through empirical studies and large-scale field experiments (see https://www.slu.se/en/departments/wildlife-fish-environmental-studies/research/research-areas/restoration-ecology/). The postdoc will collaborate with the Department of Ecology, the department of Forest Ecology and Management, and the Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) in Finland. 
About the position
The post doc will analyse data from the field survey with the aim of gaining a better understanding of factors controlling species diversity in relation to forest management. They are also expected to write scientific publications together with the research group.
Your profile
The applicant should hold a PhD in ecology (or in a similar relevant subject). As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates obtained a doctoral degree within the last three years. Experience from relevant research questions (Bayesian modeling, Species distribution modeling, terrestrial ecology, nature conservation in forests, landscape ecology, conservation strategies) is a merit. Experience from statistical analyses of large data sets is considered a merit along with a strong publication record (in relation to the time since the doctoral degree). The applicant is expected to be able to take own initiative and work independently and in a group. Excellent skills in written and oral communication in English are required.   
About us
At the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies we offer a creative and stimulating environment and perform internationally recognised basic and applied research, education and environmental monitoring in the areas of biodiversity restoration and conservation, fish biology, wildlife ecology and zoonosis. The department has a large proportion of international employees and well established national and international cooperation which gives opportunities for fruitful exchange. 
For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/department-of-wildlife-fish-and-environmental-studies/

Installation, commissioning and testing of mechanical equipment.

jobs.occupation: Research and Development Engineer in Techno-Economic Assessment
jobs.employer_name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Are you driven, analytical and eager to make a change and drive development? Join RISE Processum and work on research projects to develop the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry.
RISE is a gathering of forces for the sustainable transition that business, society, and the world need. We work with the solutions that can make a difference here and now, and with the areas of knowledge and techniques that can be crucial tomorrow.
About us At RISE Processum, we are developing the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry. Through chemistry and biotechnology, we seek to maximize resource efficiency and sustainability in the utilization of society's residual streams for new fossil-free products in food, feed, chemicals, materials and fuel. Within our cluster activities, guidance in techno-economic assessment to both large and small companies in the bioeconomy is a crucial step in the development of new sustainable and competitive concepts.
Our projects range from shorter assignments to larger national and international research projects, often in collaboration with colleagues from RISE's various areas of expertise. You will be part of the Innovationssystem group within Processum, consisting of 10 colleagues.
About the role In collaboration with a team of experts in biotechnology, chemistry, process simulations, business development and technoeconomic assessments, you will develop new research and development projects from idea to finished results. You will conduct contract research to support industry in developing roadmaps for expanding or transitioning existing businesses into competitive and sustainable new market offerings. A substantial part of the role involves developing tools and knowledge through publicly funded collaborative projects, as well as contributing to the development of internal TEA activities at RISE.
You will identify customer needs and build strong customer relationships and develop new business opportunities. This includes securing project funding, preparing funding applications, and contributing to sales and contract-based projects.
The location is Örnsköldsvik. We follow a hybrid work model that allows employees to split their working time between the office and their home workspace. The role includes travel in connection with international projects, such as attending project meetings, events, and conferences.
Who are you? To be successful in the role you are analytical, structured and self-driven. You are motivated by developing projects to create value together with colleagues and partners. You are good at building relationships and with your interest in technology from a societal perspective, you identify needs and turn them into action. You have a strong interest in project management and communication of results.
Requirements for the role
• A Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, preferably in Biotechnology or Chemistry
• Experience from working in or closely linked to bioeconomy related industries
• Experience in performing value chain analyses at different levels and techno-economic assessment, preferably on biobased processes
• Experience with process simulations tools
• Project management experience within research and development
• You speak and write fluently in Swedish or English
Are we a good match? At Processum, you will work close to one of Europe’s leading technology infrastructures for the bioeconomy and contribute to strengthening RISE’s capabilities in scale-up, testing and demonstration. You will work with a wide variety of concepts and value chains in an international and dynamic environment, with colleagues representing many different nationalities. At RISE, we like different things and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge and skills for the future.
Welcome with your application! If this sounds exciting and you want to know more, please contact Johan Börjesson, Director of Innovation Systems, johan.borjesson@ri.se, +46 738 032 315. The application deadline is December 2. Selection and interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Apply with CV and questionnaire (no cover letter needed).
Our union representatives are Frida Sandberg (+46 10 516 67 79) and Veronica Benavente (+46 76 935 86 32) for Unionen and Johanna Källman, +46 10 516 60 10 for Saco.
